label: Starting weapons: first high-resolution object icons
style: Hand-painted, realistic dark-fantasy game art in the manner of a gritty tactical RPG: believable steel, wood, leather and lacquer, painterly but precise, strong value contrast. Shapes must stay readable when the image is shrunk to 48 pixels, and each weapon must be told apart from similar weapons at a glance by its silhouette and colours.
